         **Review examples:**
            1. _MichaelMather2026_, Oct 11, 2026, 1/5: "Had been using this for years. My god what is this new interface update. Super buggy, blocks that I deleted keeping magically reappearing. The app even adds random blocks I never created. What on earth is going on over there at Opal. How can it be this bad."
            2. _Tomito6_, Oct 2, 2026, 1/5: "I payed this app for almost a year. Not worth it at all! I found a much better app that was not 20€ per month. And let me tell you that this app also often didn’t work. It’s super buggy!! For some reason my instagram always seemed to unlock between 23-24 (even if I put a lot of extra rules or changed stuff) it also often didn’t revognize time limits so it’s quite literally not doing it’s only purpose, while demanding 20€. Hoooorrrribble app. Migrated to a new one and wish I could go back in time to avoid this scam"
            3. _AverageMean_, Sep 13, 2026, 1/5: "used to love the app but its filled with bugs (apps not blocking or blocking in loops when unblocked, spamming notifications…) since the 4.x update :( is there any way to get the old app back?"
